examples.name: log-analyzer
examples.title: Large-File Log Analyzer
examples.purpose: Read a file through an explicit filesystem capability, filter and count matching lines, sort results, and write a summary.
examples.source:
app LogAnalyzer
function summarize(fs capability<filesystem>, input text, output text) -> result<boolean,text> { let contents = readTextFile(fs, input)? let lines = split(contents, "\n") let errors = filter(lines, lambda(line text) -> boolean { return textContains(line, "ERROR") }) let errorCount = fold(errors, 0, lambda(count integer, line text) -> integer { return count + 1 }) let sortedErrors = sort(errors) let summary = join(sortedErrors, "\n") let written = writeTextFile(fs, output, summary)? return ok(errorCount > 0 and written) }
